name: anim_jyu_slam_land2
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: He lands heavily on both feet with a thud, the body and belly jiggling, thick paint splashing around his feet, then he turns his body to face straight toward the viewer and puts both hands on his hips, chest and belly pushed forward, looking down. Heavy, sticky, viscous paint.
